```json
        "responses": {
          "201": {
            "description": "Invoice has been imported successfully",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "invoice": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "description": "Invoice identifier",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "wMoOACctiA"
                        },
                        "label": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Invoice label"
                        },
                        "invoice_number": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Invoice number"
                        },
                        "quote_group_uuid": {
                          "description": "Two invoices having the same quote_group_uuid are linked together",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "b50b8fe6-48ce-4380-b9b3-52eec688fc04"
                        },
                        "is_draft": {
                          "description": "Invoice draft status (set to True if the invoice is a draft)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "is_estimate": {
                          "description": "Invoice estimate status (set to True if the document is an estimate, False if it's an invoice)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "currency": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency code (ISO 4217)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "EUR"
                        },
                        "amount": {
                          "description": "Invoice amount (total value of the invoice in euros. If the currency is euro, Currency Amount and Invoice Amount are identical)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "230.32"
                        },
                        "currency_amount": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency amount (total value of the invoice in the currency of the invoice)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "230.32"
                        },
                        "currency_amount_before_tax": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency amount before tax (total value before tax of the invoice in the currency of the invoice)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "196.32"
                        },
                        "exchange_rate": {
                          "description": "Invoice exchange rate (used to convert the invoice to euros. If the invoice currency is euro it will be 1.0)",
                          "type": "number",
                          "example": 1
                        },
                        "date": {
                          "description": "Invoice issue date (ISO 8601)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2023-08-30"
                        },
                        "deadline": {
                          "description": "Invoice payment deadline (ISO 8601)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2020-09-02"
                        },
                        "currency_tax": {
                          "description": "Invoice taxable amount (in invoice currency)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "34.0"
                        },
                        "language": {
                          "description": "Language of the invoice. The locale region is separated by an underscore like in \"fr_FR\".",
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "fr_FR",
                            "en_GB"
                          ]
                        },
                        "paid": {
                          "description": "Invoice paid status (set to True if the invoice is paid)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": false
                        },
                        "fully_paid_at": {
                          "description": "Invoice payment date",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2023-08-30"
                        },
                        "status": {
                          "description": "Invoice status",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "upcoming"
                        },
                        "discount": {
                          "description": "Invoice discount (which is a percentage if the discount_type is \"relative\", or an amount if the discount_type is \"absolute\")",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "50.1"
                        },
                        "discount_type": {
                          "description": "Discount type.\n- absolute if it is an amount\n- relative if it is a percentage\n",
                          "type": "string",
                          "default": "relative",
                          "enum": [
                            "absolute",
                            "relative"
                          ]
                        },
                        "public_url": {
                          "description": "Public url of the invoice",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "https://app.pennylane.com/..."
                        },
                        "file_url": {
                          "description": "If there's a file attached to the invoice, this is the link of the file",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "https://app.pennylane.com/.../file.pdf"
                        },
                        "filename": {
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "my_file.pdf",
                          "description": "Name of the file attached to the invoice"
                        },
                        "remaining_amount": {
                          "description": "The remaining amount to pay for the invoice to be considered paid",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "20.0"
                        },
                        "source": {
                          "description": "Where the invoice is coming from, here are the different values:\n  - quotes: Created directly from the editor\n  - stripe: Imported from Stripe\n  - other: Other cases\n",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "email"
                        },
                        "special_mention": {
                          "description": "Additional details",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Additional details"
                        },

                          "description": "This will set the invoice to Incomplete status",
                          "type": "boolean"

                        "updated_at": {
                          "description": "The last time the invoice has been updated",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date-time",
                          "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"

                          "type": "object",

                              "description": "End date of the imputation period (ISO 8601)",
                              "type": "string",
                              "format": "date",
                              "example": "2021-06-30"

                            "start_date",
```

# Create an invoice

This endpoint allows you to create a invoice based on a specific payload. Pennylane will generate a pdf for you.

How the create and update flags are working together:
  - create_customer: true, update_customer: true => create the customer or update the customer
  - create_customer: true, update_customer: false => create the customer or raise an error
    The api will check that all the customer attributes given are the same in this case
  - create_customer: false, update_customer: false => find the existing customer or raise an error
  - create_customer: false, update_customer: true => find the existing customer and update it

```json
                        "properties": {

                            "description": "The banking provider for the transaction",
                            "type": "string",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "bank"

                          "provider_field_name": {
                            "description": "Name of the field that you want to match",
                            "type": "string",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "label"
                          },
                          "provider_field_value": {
                            "description": "Value that you want to match",
                            "type": "string",
                            "nullable": true,
                            "example": "invoice_number"
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [

                          "provider_field_name",
                          "provider_field_value"

                          },
                          "invoice_number-example": {
                            "banking_provider": "bank",
                            "provider_field_name": "label",

                          }
                        }

        "responses": {
          "201": {
            "description": "Invoice has been created successfully",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "invoice": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "description": "Invoice identifier",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "wMoOACctiA"
                        },
                        "label": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Invoice label"
                        },
                        "invoice_number": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Invoice number"
                        },
                        "quote_group_uuid": {
                          "description": "Two invoices having the same quote_group_uuid are linked together",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "b50b8fe6-48ce-4380-b9b3-52eec688fc04"
                        },
                        "is_draft": {
                          "description": "Invoice draft status (set to True if the invoice is a draft)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "is_estimate": {
                          "description": "Invoice estimate status (set to True if the document is an estimate, False if it's an invoice)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "currency": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency code (ISO 4217)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "EUR"
                        },
                        "amount": {
                          "description": "Invoice amount (total value of the invoice in euros. If the currency is euro, Currency Amount and Invoice Amount are identical)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "230.32"
                        },
                        "currency_amount": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency amount (total value of the invoice in the currency of the invoice)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "230.32"
                        },
                        "currency_amount_before_tax": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency amount before tax (total value before tax of the invoice in the currency of the invoice)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "196.32"
                        },
                        "exchange_rate": {
                          "description": "Invoice exchange rate (used to convert the invoice to euros. If the invoice currency is euro it will be 1.0)",
                          "type": "number",
                          "example": 1
                        },
                        "date": {
                          "description": "Invoice issue date (ISO 8601)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2023-08-30"
                        },
                        "deadline": {
                          "description": "Invoice payment deadline (ISO 8601)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2020-09-02"
                        },
                        "currency_tax": {
                          "description": "Invoice taxable amount (in invoice currency)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "34.0"
                        },
                        "language": {
                          "description": "Language of the invoice. The locale region is separated by an underscore like in \"fr_FR\".",
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "fr_FR",
                            "en_GB"
                          ]
                        },
                        "paid": {
                          "description": "Invoice paid status (set to True if the invoice is paid)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": false
                        },
                        "fully_paid_at": {
                          "description": "Invoice payment date",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2023-08-30"
                        },
                        "status": {
                          "description": "Invoice status",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "upcoming"
                        },
                        "discount": {
                          "description": "Invoice discount (which is a percentage if the discount_type is \"relative\", or an amount if the discount_type is \"absolute\")",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "50.1"
                        },
                        "discount_type": {
                          "description": "Discount type.\n- absolute if it is an amount\n- relative if it is a percentage\n",
                          "type": "string",
                          "default": "relative",
                          "enum": [
                            "absolute",
                            "relative"
                          ]
                        },
                        "public_url": {
                          "description": "Public url of the invoice",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "https://app.pennylane.com/..."
                        },
                        "file_url": {
                          "description": "If there's a file attached to the invoice, this is the link of the file",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "https://app.pennylane.com/.../file.pdf"
                        },
                        "filename": {
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "my_file.pdf",
                          "description": "Name of the file attached to the invoice"
                        },
                        "remaining_amount": {
                          "description": "The remaining amount to pay for the invoice to be considered paid",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "20.0"
                        },
                        "source": {
                          "description": "Where the invoice is coming from, here are the different values:\n  - quotes: Created directly from the editor\n  - stripe: Imported from Stripe\n  - other: Other cases\n",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "email"
                        },
                        "special_mention": {
                          "description": "Additional details",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Additional details"
                        },
                        "customer_validation_needed": {
                          "description": "This will set the invoice to Incomplete status",
                          "type": "boolean"
                        },
                        "updated_at": {
                          "description": "The last time the invoice has been updated",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date-time",
                          "example": "2023-08-30T10:08:08.146343Z"
                        },
                        "imputation_dates": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "additionalProperties": false,
                          "properties": {
                            "start_date": {
                              "description": "Start date of the imputation period (ISO 8601)",
                              "type": "string",
                              "format": "date",
                              "example": "2020-06-30"
                            },
                            "end_date": {
                              "description": "End date of the imputation period (ISO 8601)",
                              "type": "string",
                              "format": "date",
                              "example": "2021-06-30"
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "start_date",
                            "end_date"
                          ]
                        },

                                  "type": "object",
                                  "additionalProperties": false,
                                  "properties": {

                                      "description": "Customer address (billing address)",

                                      "example": "4 rue du faubourg saint martin"
                                    },
                                    "postal_code": {
                                      "description": "Postal code (billing address)",
                                      "type": "string",
                                      "example": "75010"

                                      "type": "string",
                                      "example": "FR"

                                "delivery_address": {
                                  "type": "object",
                                  "additionalProperties": false,
                                  "properties": {

                                      "type": "string",

                                      "description": "Postal code (billing address)",
                                      "type": "string",

                                      "description": "City (billing address)",
                                      "type": "string",
                                      "example": "Paris"
                                    },
                                    "country_alpha2": {
                                      "description": "Country alpha code (billing address)",
                                      "type": "string",
                                      "example": "FR"
                                    }
                                  }

                                  "description": "Recipient displayed in the invoice",
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "example": "On the behalf of John"

                                "vat_number": {
                                  "description": "Customer's VAT number",
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "example": "12345678901"

                                  "description": "You can use your own id when creating the customer. If not provided, Pennylane will pick one for you. Id must be unique",
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "nullable": false,
                                  "example": "38a1f19a-256d-4692-a8fe-0a16403f59ff"
                                },
                                "emails": {
                                  "type": "array",
                                  "items": {
                                    "type": "string"
                                  },
                                  "example": [
                                    "hello@example.org"
                                  ]

                                "billing_iban": {
                                  "description": "The billing IBAN of the customer. This is the iban on which you wish to receive payment from this customer.",
```

# Edit Invoice Lines

Edit (create and delete) invoice lines for a given invoice. It is not possible to update existing invoice lines. Delete and recreate them using this endpoint.

# Send an invoice or an estimate by email

This endpoint allows you to send a finalized invoice or an estimate by email to your customer. This requires that the PDF file for that document has been generated (this process can take a few minutes), so if you just created the invoice / estimate in our system, we may return a 409 error. You should retry the request in a few minutes - if you receive a 204 response, that means that the email is on its way. For more information about email sending, please read [this guide](https://pennylane.readme.io/docs/how-to-send-estimates-invoices-by-emails).

# Create an estimate

This endpoint allows you to create an estimate based on a specific payload. Pennylane will generate a pdf for you.

How the create and update flags are working together:
  - create_customer: true, update_customer: true => create the customer or update the customer
  - create_customer: true, update_customer: false => create the customer or raise an error
    The api will check that all the customer attributes given are the same in this case
  - create_customer: false, update_customer: false => find the existing customer or raise an error
  - create_customer: false, update_customer: true => find the existing customer and update it

```json
                        },

                          "description": "Estimate currency amount (total value of the estimate in the currency of the estimate)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "230.32"
                        },

                            "purchasing_order",
                            "purchase_request"

                          "example": 1

                        "date": {
                          "description": "Estimate issue date",

                          "example": "2020-01-01"
```

This endpoint allows you to update the parameters of an subscription as well as the list of products and amount of the upcoming invoices.

This endpoint returns a list of customers corresponding to the filter provided. Please refer to [the filters page](https://pennylane.readme.io/v1.0/docs/how-to-set-up-filters) to learn how to correctly build the `filter` parameter.

# Create a customer

This endpoint allows you to create a customer based on a specific payload. You can even provide your own id.


# OpenAPI definition
```json
{
  "openapi": "3.0.1",
  "info": {
    "title": "Referentials",
    "description": "Object definitions and their corresponding APIs used within the Pennylane API.",

    },
    "version": "1.0.0"
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://app.pennylane.com"
    }
  ],
  "tags": [
    {
      "name": "Customers",
      "description": "Create, Read, Update & List your customers"
    }
  ],
  "paths": {
    "/api/external/v1/customers": {
      "post": {
        "operationId": "customers-post",
        "summary": "Create a customer",
        "description": "This endpoint allows you to create a customer based on a specific payload. You can even provide your own id.",
        "tags": [
          "Customers"
        ],
        "security": [
          {
            "oauth2": [
              "customer_invoices"
            ]
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "customer": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "title": "Company Customer",
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "customer_type": {
                            "description": "Type of the customer. Must be company",
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "company"
                            ]
                          },
                          "name": {
                            "description": "Company name",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "Pennylane"
                          },
                          "reg_no": {
                            "description": "Customer registration number (SIREN)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "XXXXXXXXX"
                          },
                          "address": {
                            "description": "Customer address (billing address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "4 rue du faubourg saint martin"
                          },
                          "postal_code": {
                            "description": "Postal code (billing address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "75010"
                          },
                          "city": {
                            "description": "City (billing address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "Paris"
                          },
                          "country_alpha2": {
                            "description": "Any ISO 3166 Alpha-2 country code (billing address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "FR"
                          },
                          "recipient": {
                            "description": "Recipient displayed in the invoice",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "On the behalf of John"
                          },
                          "vat_number": {
                            "description": "Customer's VAT number",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "12345678901"
                          },
                          "source_id": {
                            "description": "You can use your own id when creating the customer. If not provided, Pennylane will pick one for you. Id must be unique",
                            "type": "string",
                            "nullable": false,
                            "example": "38a1f19a-256d-4692-a8fe-0a16403f59ff"
                          },
                          "emails": {
                            "type": "array",
                            "items": {
                              "type": "string"
                            },
                            "example": [
                              "hello@example.org"
                            ]
                          },
                          "billing_iban": {
                            "description": "The billing IBAN of the customer. This is the iban on which you wish to receive payment from this customer.",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "FRXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXX"
                          },
                          "delivery_address": {
                            "description": "Address (shipping address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "33 rue du mail"
                          },
                          "delivery_postal_code": {
                            "description": "Postal code (shipping address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "75002"
                          },
                          "delivery_city": {
                            "description": "City (shipping address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "Paris"
                          },
                          "delivery_country_alpha2": {
                            "description": "Any ISO 3166 Alpha-2 country code (shipping address)",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "FR"
                          },
                          "payment_conditions": {
                            "description": "Customer payment conditions",
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "upon_receipt",
                              "custom",
                              "15_days",
                              "30_days",
                              "45_days",
                              "60_days"
                            ]
                          },
                          "phone": {
                            "description": "Customer phone number",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "+33123232323"
                          },
                          "reference": {
                            "description": "This reference doesn't appear on the invoice",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "This is a custom reference"
                          },
                          "notes": {
                            "description": "Notes about the customer",
                            "type": "string",
                            "example": "This is a note"
                          },
                          "mandate": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                              "provider": {
                                "description": "The mandate provider",
                                "type": "string",
                                "enum": [
                                  "gocardless"
                                ]
                              },
                              "source_id": {
                                "description": "The provider's unique identifier of a mandate",
                                "type": "string",
                                "example": "MD001H23WP8E7XN"
                              }
                            },
                            "required": [
                              "source_id"
                            ]
                          },
                          "plan_item": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "additionalProperties": false,
                            "properties": {
                              "number": {
                                "description": "If left empty, the system will automatically assign a default number to the plan item.",
                                "type": "string"
                              },
                              "label": {
                                "type": "string"
                              },
                              "enabled": {
                                "type": "boolean"
                              },
                              "vat_rate": {
                                "type": "string"
                              },
                              "country_alpha2": {
                                "type": "string"

                              "description": {

                          "address",
                          "postal_code",
```

# Create a Billing Subscription

This endpoint allows you to create a subscription based on a specific payload. Pennylane will generate the invoice each month. You can also link the subscription to a GoCardless mandate.

```json
          "201": {
            "description": "Invoice has been imported successfully",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "properties": {
                    "invoice": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "additionalProperties": false,

                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Invoice label"

                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "Invoice number"
                        },
                        "quote_group_uuid": {
                          "description": "Two invoices having the same quote_group_uuid are linked together",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "b50b8fe6-48ce-4380-b9b3-52eec688fc04"
                        },
                        "is_draft": {
                          "description": "Invoice draft status (set to True if the invoice is a draft)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "is_estimate": {
                          "description": "Invoice estimate status (set to True if the document is an estimate, False if it's an invoice)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": true
                        },
                        "currency": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency code (ISO 4217)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "EUR"
                        },
                        "amount": {
                          "description": "Invoice amount (total value of the invoice in euros. If the currency is euro, Currency Amount and Invoice Amount are identical)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "230.32"
                        },
                        "currency_amount": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency amount (total value of the invoice in the currency of the invoice)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "230.32"
                        },
                        "currency_amount_before_tax": {
                          "description": "Invoice currency amount before tax (total value before tax of the invoice in the currency of the invoice)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "196.32"
                        },
                        "exchange_rate": {
                          "description": "Invoice exchange rate (used to convert the invoice to euros. If the invoice currency is euro it will be 1.0)",
                          "type": "number",
                          "example": 1
                        },
                        "date": {
                          "description": "Invoice issue date (ISO 8601)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2023-08-30"
                        },
                        "deadline": {
                          "description": "Invoice payment deadline (ISO 8601)",

                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2024-08-30"

                          "description": "Invoice taxable amount (in invoice currency)",

                            "en_GB"

                        },
                        "paid": {
                          "description": "Invoice paid status (set to True if the invoice is paid)",
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "example": false

                          "description": "Invoice payment date",
                          "type": "string",
                          "format": "date",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "2023-08-30"
                        },
                        "status": {
                          "description": "Invoice status",
                          "type": "string",
                          "nullable": true,
                          "example": "upcoming"

                        "discount": {
                          "description": "Invoice discount Amount (total discounted amount on the invoice. Set to 0.0 if the invoice does not have any discount. If the discount is relative, set as a percentage value between 0 and 1)",
                          "type": "string",
                          "example": "50.1"
                        },
```

# List all invoices

This endpoint returns a list of supplier invoices corresponding to the filter provided. Please refer to [the filters page](https://pennylane.readme.io/docs/how-to-set-up-filters) to learn how to correctly build the `filter` parameter.
